description: agro CLI disposable hands: --disposable on agro node create and agro hands create (console), clear lines for HTTP 422 DISPOSABLE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED and HTTP 409 NODE_DISPOSABLE, help text, and changelog (follow-up of mifunedev/agro-console#786).

userStories.title: Create a disposable node with agro node create
userStories.description: As a console user, I want `agro node create --disposable` to request a disposable node. I then get a hand with no data volume without a call to the raw API.
acceptanceCriteria: `agro node create --disposable` sends `"disposable": true` in the `POST /api/nodes` body. Without the flag, the body holds no `disposable` key.
After a credit refusal, the free `n4` retry of `createConsoleNode` keeps `"disposable": true`.
When the console answers HTTP 422 `DISPOSABLE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED`, the command prints `only a sandbox node can be disposable: drop --disposable, or use --profile sandbox` to stderr and exits 1.
The CLI sends the request for `--profile agro --disposable`, and the console refuses the request. The CLI adds no local profile rule.

The `create` help text in `.agro/cli/src/commands/node.ts` names `--disposable` and states these rules: A disposable node has no data volume. Pause, resume, fork, snapshot, convert, and disk grow return HTTP 409 `NODE_DISPOSABLE`. `agro node delete <id>` deletes the node. The platform deletes a running disposable node at the end of the credit grace window after the low-balance email. The platform also deletes a running disposable node at the end of the free-tier allowance.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` fail before the change and pass after the change. The tests cover the body with and without the flag, the free `n4` retry, and the HTTP 422 line.
`npm run typecheck` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Accepted at 3580b966 (advisor): --disposable sends disposable:true (absent without the flag); the free n4 retry keeps the field (console-api.ts unchanged, the body spreads); HTTP 422 DISPOSABLE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED prints the exact line and exits 1; no local profile rule; help names the flag, the 409 operations, agro node delete, and both deletion triggers. npx vitest run node.test.ts hands.test.ts: 158 pass (red first: 5 failed). npm run typecheck: exit 0.

userStories.title: Create a disposable hand and explain the refused verbs in agro hands
userStories.description: As a brain, I want `agro hands create --disposable` and a clear line for each verb that a disposable hand refuses. I then create a short-lived hand and know how to delete the hand.
acceptanceCriteria: `HandRequest` in `.agro/cli/src/lib/hands/provider.ts` gets the optional boolean `disposable`. The console provider sends `"disposable": true` when the request sets it.
`agro hands create --disposable` creates a disposable hand through the console provider.
With `hands.provider` `exedev`, `agro hands create --disposable` exits 1 before any provider call and prints `--disposable applies only to console hands`.

When the console answers HTTP 409 `NODE_DISPOSABLE` to `agro hands pause`, `agro hands resume`, or `agro hands fork`, the command prints `hand <ref> is disposable and cannot <verb>: delete it with agro hands destroy <ref>` to stderr and exits 1.
Any other refusal keeps its current message.
The `create` help text in `.agro/cli/src/commands/hands.ts` names `--disposable`, the console-only rule, the refused verbs, the delete command, and the deletion rule of US-001.
`CHANGELOG.md` `## [Unreleased]` lists the flag under `### Added`. The entry names `--disposable`, HTTP 409 `NODE_DISPOSABLE`, HTTP 422 `DISPOSABLE_PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED`, and the deletion rule.
`docs/lifecycle-commands.md` stays unchanged.
Tests in `.agro/cli/src/commands/__tests__/hands.test.ts` and the console provider tests in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` fail before the change and pass after the change.
`npm run typecheck` exits 0.
userStories.notes: Accepted at 15df0547 (advisor): HandRequest.disposable; console provider sends disposable:true (kept on the free n4 retry); hands create --disposable; exedev refusal before any call; refusalMessage maps 409 NODE_DISPOSABLE on pause, resume, fork to the delete line, other refusals and destroy unchanged; help text with the console-only rule, refused verbs, destroy command, both deletion triggers; CHANGELOG Unreleased Added bullet. docs/lifecycle-commands.md unchanged. npx vitest run node, hands, hands-exedev, sandbox-routing tests: 280 pass (red first: 10 failed). npm run typecheck: exit 0.

userStories.title: Capture the manual review transcript
userStories.description: As the reviewer, I want a command transcript of each disposable path. The PR then shows the behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/cli-disposable-hands/evidence/manual-review.md` records these commands through `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js` after `npm --prefix .agro/cli run build`, against a local stub console: `node create --disposable`, with the request body that the stub received; `node create --profile agro --disposable`, with the HTTP 422 line; `hands pause`, `hands resume`, and `hands fork` on a disposable hand, each with the HTTP 409 line.
The story commits the stub source as `evidence/stub-console.mjs`. The story adds each evidence file with `git add -f`, because `.gitignore` ignores task evidence.
Before the run, the story checks that the stub port is free. If the port is busy, the story sets `blocked`, names the process, and stops no process.
The story passes each environment value inline and uses a throwaway token. The story writes no env file and no credentials file. The story deletes its temp directory after the run.
`external` After the agro release, the operator approves one live run. The run creates one disposable hand on agro-console, records the refused `pause`, and deletes the hand.
